units.source_text: 当然，我并非没有辩解的余地。

en.t: Of course, it was not as if I had no room to defend myself.

units.source_text: 如果我不践踏那个女人，外国兵也许会掏出手枪来威胁我的性命。

en.t: If I had not trampled on that woman, the foreign soldier might have pulled out his pistol and threatened my life.

units.source_text: 不能反抗占领军，所有这一切，我都是在被威胁的情况下干出来的。

en.t: I could not resist the occupying forces; everything I did was done under threat.
